description: Odnawialne źródła energii - monitoring is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstwo Klimatu i Środowiska. Realizując ustawowy obowiązek Ministra właściwego ds. klimatu zawarty w art. 131 ust. 1 ustawy z dnia 20 lutego 2015 r. o odnawialnych źródłach energii (Dz.U. z 2020 r. poz. 261 z późn. Coverage: Ministerstwo Klimatu i Środowiska. The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstwo Klimatu i Środowiska. Its keywords include monitoring, odnawialne źródła energii, ure, GUS, ciepło, OZE. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
